item.title: How to apply for TSA PreCheck and CLEAR amid long airport security lines
item.description: The ongoing government shutdown has caused a shortage of TSA agents, leading to longer security wait times at airports, but enrolling in programs like TSA PreCheck and CLEAR+ could cut your wait time.

item.title: Foggy start again, then another warm afternoon
item.description: Dense fog is impacting parts of Southeast Texas this morning, with reduced visibility possible for the commute. Conditions will improve later today as temperatures climb into the upper 80s, with near-90-degree heat expected by midweek.

item.title: NASA shares new plan for Moon return and future base
item.description: NASA is outlining how it plans to send astronauts back to the Moon and begin building a future lunar base. Watch the live event starting at 8 a.m. on CW39+.

item.title: NTSB chair: LaGuardia crash investigator was stuck in TSA line for hours
item.description: The head of the National Transportation Safety Board said Monday that long lines at airport security checkpoints caused by the ongoing Department of Homeland Security (DHS) shutdown delayed investigators arriving at the scene of a deadly collision between a jet and a fire truck at LaGuardia International Airport.

item.title: When to see bluebonnets in Texas: 2026 bloom may be brief
item.description: Texas bluebonnet season is already underway, but experts warn the 2026 bloom may be shorter and more scattered due to warm, dry conditions. Here’s when to go and where to find the best spots near Houston.

item.title: Houston Comets set to return as WNBA franchise in 2027
item.description: Houston may get a WNBA franchise as the Connecticut Sun is reportedly being sold to Houston Rockets owner Tilman Fertitta.

item.title: Student shoots teacher at Texas high school, then turns gun on himself
item.description: A student shot a teacher at a Central Texas high school and then fatally shot himself, authorities said.

item.title: 5-year-old child drowns in neighbor's pool near Galena Park, HCSO says
item.description: A 5-year-old child has died in a drowning incident in a home near Galena Park, Harris County authorities said.

item.title: Reward for 'Subzero Suspect' bank robber now at $25,000, FBI says
item.description: The reward for a hooded bank robber named by authorities as the “Subzero Suspect” has increased to $25,000.

item.title: What to know about partial DHS shutdown as TSA officers start getting paid
item.description: Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officers started getting retroactive paychecks on Monday for the weeks they have worked without pay during the partial 44-day shutdown of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

item.title: Texas lawmakers to study data center development amid water, electricity concerns
item.description: State legislative leaders released their interim charges last week, a list of topics they want lawmakers to investigate over the next year in the lead up to the next legislative session in 2027. A major theme sprinkled throughout the charges is the impact of data centers.

item.title: Texas ya no permite comprar dulces ni sodas con SNAP desde el 1 de abril
item.description: A partir del 1 de abril de 2026, las familias en Texas que reciben beneficios de SNAP ya no podrán usar su Lone Star Card para comprar dulces, chicles, sodas ni bebidas con endulzantes artificiales. Te explicamos qué cambió, qué sí puedes comprar todavía, y cómo saber si calificas para recibir ayuda.

item.title: What could stop NASA's Moon mission Wednesday?
item.description: NASA is 80% confident Wednesday's Artemis II launch will go as planned — but clouds, high winds, and technical red lines could still stop the clock. Here's what needs to go right for liftoff at 5:24 p.m.

item.title: Texas hammers Michigan, secures 2nd consecutive Final Four berth
item.description: AUSTIN (KXAN) — Texas is headed to another Final Four. The top-seeded Longhorns made their first nine shots to run away with a 77-41 win over second-seeded Michigan in the Elite Eight on Monday at Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, Texas. Texas advanced to its second consecutive Final Four, and the fifth in program history. [...]
